H6208.name: Arkites
H6208.brief: Canaanite people group descended from Canaan
H6208.short: The Arkites were one of the Canaanite tribes descended from Canaan, the son of Ham, and are mentioned in the Table of Nations.

H6214H.name: Asahel
H6214H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6214H.brief: Levite sent by Jehoshaphat to teach the Law
H6214H.short: Asahel was a Levite sent by Jehoshaphat to teach the Book of the Law in Judah (<ref="2Ch.17.8">2Ch.17.8</ref>).

H6214I.name: Asahel
H6214I.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6214I.brief: Levite in charge of tithes under Hezekiah
H6214I.short: Asahel was a Levite appointed by Hezekiah to distribute the tithes and dedicated things (<ref="2Ch.31.13">2Ch.31.13</ref>).

H6214G.name: Asahel
H6214G.desc: David's compatriot living at the time of United Monarchy
H6214G.brief: Son of Zeruiah, brother of Joab, killed by Abner
H6214G.short: Asahel, son of Zeruiah and brother of Joab, was a fast runner killed by Abner during a battle (<ref="2Sam 2; 3:27, 30; 23:24; 1Ch.2.16; 11:26; 27:7">2Sam 2; 3:27, 30; 23:24; 1Ch.2.16; 11:26; 27:7</ref>).

H6214J.name: Asahel
H6214J.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H6214J.brief: Opposed Ezra's dissolution of mixed marriages
H6214J.short: Asahel, along with Jahzeiah, opposed Ezra's plan to dissolve mixed marriages among the returned exiles (<ref="Ezra 10:15">Ezra 10:15</ref>).

H6222K.name: Asaiah
H6222K.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6222K.brief: Levite leader who helped bring the ark to Jerusalem
H6222K.short: Asaiah was a Levite leader who assisted in bringing the ark of the covenant to Jerusalem during David's reign (<ref="1Ch.15.6, 11">1Ch.15.6, 11</ref>).

H6222H.name: Asaiah
H6222H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6222H.short: Asaiah was a Simeonite leader during the reign of King Hezekiah (<ref="1Ch.4.36">1Ch.4.36</ref>).

H6222I.name: Asaiah
H6222I.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6222I.brief: Merarite Levite, ancestor of Ethan the singer
H6222I.short: Asaiah was a Merarite Levite, an ancestor of Ethan the singer (<ref="1Ch.6.30">1Ch.6.30</ref>).

H6222J.name: Asaiah
H6222J.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H6222J.brief: Descendant of Judah living in Jerusalem
H6222J.short: Asaiah, a descendant of Judah, lived in Jerusalem (<ref="1Ch.9.5">1Ch.9.5</ref>).

H6222G.name: Asaiah
H6222G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6222G.brief: Servant of King Josiah during Book of Law discovery
H6222G.short: Asaiah was a servant of King Josiah sent to consult the prophetess Huldah about the Book of the Law (<ref="2Ki.22.12, 14; 2Ch.34.20">2Ki.22.12, 14; 2Ch.34.20</ref>).

H6220.name: Ashvath
H6220.brief: Son of Japhlet, descendant of Asher
H6220.short: Ashvath was a son of Japhlet and a descendant of Asher (<ref="1Ch.7.33">1Ch.7.33</ref>).

H6221.name: Asiel
H6221.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6221.short: Asiel was a descendant of Simeon mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe (<ref="1Ch.4.35">1Ch.4.35</ref>).

H6265.name: Athaiah
H6265.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H6265.brief: Descendant of Judah who resettled in Jerusalem
H6265.short: Athaiah, a descendant of Judah, was one of the people who resettled in Jerusalem after the exile (<ref="Neh.11.4">Neh.11.4</ref>).

H6271H.name: Athaliah
H6271H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6271H.short: Athaliah was a descendant of Benjamin mentioned in the genealogy of Saul's family (<ref="1Ch.8.26">1Ch.8.26</ref>).

H6271G.name: Athaliah
H6271G.desc: Queen living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6271G.brief: Queen of Judah, daughter of Ahab and Jezebel
H6271G.short: Athaliah, the daughter of Ahab and Jezebel, became queen of Judah and ruled for six years before being overthrown (<ref="2Ki.8.26; 11:1-3, 13-14, 20; 2Ch.22.2, 10-12; 23:12-13, 21; 24:7">2Ki.8.26; 11:1-3, 13-14, 20; 2Ch.22.2, 10-12; 23:12-13, 21; 24:7</ref>).

H6271I.name: Athaliah
H6271I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H6271I.brief: Descendant of Elam who returned from Babylonian exile
H6271I.short: Athaliah, a descendant of Elam, was among those who returned to Jerusalem with Ezra (<ref="Ezr.8.7">Ezr.8.7</ref>).

H6270.name: Athlai
H6270.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H6270.brief: One of those who agreed to put away foreign wives
H6270.short: Athlai was one of the men who agreed to put away their foreign wives during Ezra's reforms (<ref="Ezr.10.28">Ezr.10.28</ref>).

H6262H.name: Attai
H6262H.desc: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6262H.brief: One of David's mighty men, a Gadite warrior
H6262H.short: Attai the son of Zabad was one of David's mighty men, a Gadite warrior who joined him at Ziklag (<ref="1Ch.12.11">1Ch.12.11</ref>).

H6262G.name: Attai
H6262G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6262G.brief: Grandson of Sheshan, descendant of Judah
H6262G.short: Attai was the grandson of Sheshan, a descendant of Judah (<ref="1Ch.2.35-36">1Ch.2.35-36</ref>).

H6262I.name: Attai
H6262I.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6262I.brief: Son of King Rehoboam and Maacah
H6262I.short: Attai was a son of King Rehoboam of Judah and his wife Maacah (<ref="2Ch.11.20">2Ch.11.20</ref>).

H6215G.name: Esau
H6215G.desc: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
H6215G.brief: Isaac's firstborn son; sold birthright to Jacob; became Edom.
H6215G.short: Esau, also called Edom, was Isaac's firstborn son who sold his birthright to his twin brother Jacob and became the father of the Edomites.

H6204.name: Orpah
H6204.short: Orpah was Naomi's daughter-in-law who stayed in Moab after the death of her husband, while Ruth accompanied Naomi to Bethlehem.

H6273.name: Othni
H6273.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6273.brief: Son of Shemaiah, gatekeeper of the ark
H6273.short: Othni was a son of Shemaiah and served as a gatekeeper for the ark of the covenant.

H6274.name: Othniel
H6274.brief: First judge of Israel, Caleb's nephew
H6274.short: Othniel, Caleb's nephew, was the first judge of Israel who delivered the people from Cushan-Rishathaim.

H6295.name: Pagiel
H6295.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H6295.brief: Leader of the tribe of Asher
H6295.short: Pagiel, son of Ochran, was the leader of the tribe of Asher during the wilderness wanderings.

H6228.name: Ashan
H6228.brief: A city allotted to Judah and Simeon.
H6228.short: Ashan, a city assigned to the tribes of Judah and Simeon, later given to the Levites.

H6252H.name: Ashtaroth
H6252H.brief: A city of Og, king of Bashan.
H6252H.short: Ashtaroth or Beeshterah, a city in Bashan, ruled by King Og and later allotted to the Levites.

H6255.name: Ashteroth-karnaim
H6255.short: Ashteroth-karnaim was a city east of the Jordan River defeated by King Chedorlaomer.

H6269.name: Athach
H6269.brief: A town that received spoils from David's victory.
H6269.short: Athach, a town in Judah that received a share of the spoils from David's victory over the Amalekites.

H6215I.name: Esau Mount
H6215I.brief: Mountainous region of Edom; judgment prophesied by Obadiah
H6215I.short: Mount Esau, the mountainous region of Edom, against which the prophet Obadiah declared God's judgment for their hostility toward Israel.

H6230.name: Esek
H6230.brief: Well dug by Isaac's servants; named after quarrel
H6230.short: Esek, a well dug by Isaac's servants, named after a quarrel with local herdsmen.

H6281.name: Ether
H6281.brief: City allotted to Judah and Simeon
H6281.short: Ether, a city allotted to the tribes of Judah and Simeon in the Shephelah region.

H6278.name: Eth-kazin
H6278.brief: Border town of Zebulun near Neah
H6278.short: Eth-kazin, a border town of Zebulun located near Neah.

H6290G.name: Paran
H6290G.brief: A desert region in the Sinai Peninsula
H6290G.short: Paran was a desert region in the Sinai Peninsula, associated with the Israelites' wanderings and the early life of Ishmael.

H6290H.name: Paran Mount
H6290H.brief: A mountain associated with God's appearance
H6290H.short: Mount Paran is mentioned in poetic passages as a place from which God comes or shines forth.

H6252G.name: Ashtaroth
H6252G.brief: A Canaanite goddess of fertility and war
H6252G.short: Ashtaroth was a Canaanite goddess of fertility and war whose worship was condemned in the Bible.

H6253.name: Ashtoreth
H6253.brief: A Syrian goddess of fertility and war
H6253.short: Ashtoreth, was a Sidonian goddess of fertility and war whose worship was condemned in the Bible.
